inputs.text: [dry, precise, fussy, deadpan] Wonderful. Now I'll need evidence... of the evidence.
[misty-eyed, moved, voice cracking] The evidence... it was all there.
[misty-eyed, moved, voice cracking, after a pause] I don't know what to do with my hands.

voice.name: David - Slow & Charming
voice.about: A calm, seasoned documentary narrator who savors every single word. Extremely charming, slow, relaxed, with long deliberate pauses. A mature, warm German male voice with a deeply comforting and charmingly witty tone. The delivery is deadpan, dryly ironic, and beautifully unhurried, commenting on events with a subtle, affectionate smile.
